steps.en: Work items are created for changed and unchanged vehicles
steps.id: Work item dibuat untuk kendaraan yang berubah dan tidak berubah
steps.why_en: No work item is created for ownership checks; other work item code is a placeholder.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada work item untuk pengecekan kepemilikan; code work item lain hanya placeholder.

steps.en: Add and remove candidates are found by criteria
steps.id: Kandidat tambah dan hapus ditemukan lewat kriteria
steps.why_en: There is no hitlist and no rule counting offences per ID.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada hitlist dan tidak ada aturan yang menghitung offence per ID.

steps.en: Work items appear on the officer dashboard
steps.id: Work item muncul di dashboard officer
steps.why_en: The work item menu is commented out and no such page exists.
steps.why_id: Menu work item di-comment dan halamannya tidak ada.

steps.en: The officer reviews the tagging records
steps.why_en: No review screen or data exists for tagging records.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada layar atau data review untuk record tagging.
